title: B3 BUILD: PRECEDENT.md v1 - hybrid ratio model with corrective path, three operations, graded force, validity conditions, fact re-description constraint, realist frame
description: Revise PRECEDENT.md from v0 to v1 so the shipped contract states the doctrine the addendum fixes and coordinator decisions A1-A7 adopt: the hybrid ratio model (author declares at write time, successor retains the corrective path, correction only by reinterpreting the SOURCE MATERIALS with recorded reasoning at sufficient authority - correction without sources is mere disagreement and invalid), the three operations kept structurally separate, graded force distinguished from issuance tier, validity conditions distinct from scope conditions, the fact-re-description constraint on distinguishing, and the realist frame (records are dispositions and the norm is what a successor extracts; precedents are second-degree documents; no mechanism may presuppose recoverable collective intent). Cites the addendum by DOI, never by local path. Runs in parallel with the code (T-353/T-354) and with INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md (T-356) by design; drift between document and shipped code is caught at T-360, which is the whole reason that verifier exists.

CONTENT FLOOR - six named sections, each of which T-360 will check by name. (a) THE HYBRID RATIO MODEL: the author session declares its ratio at write time as the primary reference (institutional fixation, cf. the Mexican tesis jurisprudenciales analogue) AND the successor retains the CORRECTIVE PATH - it may argue the declared ratio is merely apparent, but ONLY by reinterpreting the source materials that produced the decision, with recorded reasoning, at sufficient authority level; correction without sources is mere disagreement and is INVALID, and every record therefore carries a sources field (addendum section 3, A1). (b) THE THREE OPERATIONS, structurally separate: determination of the ratio, reinterpretation (declarative, corrective-restrictive, corrective-extensive), and valuation - stating explicitly that valuation is METATEXTUAL: it changes force, not meaning (addendum section 2, A4). (c) GRADED FORCE with reiteration and decay, explicitly distinguished from authority_tier, which remains ISSUANCE authority - a single verdicted decision still binds at issuance; what reiteration changes is the ceiling, not the floor (A2, addendum section 5). (d) VALIDITY CONDITIONS versus scope conditions, with the periodic pass flagging RECONSIDERATION CANDIDATES and never auto-expiring anything (addendum section 6, A5). (e) THE FACT-RE-DESCRIPTION CONSTRAINT: every distinguishing move must state WHICH material facts differ and WHY the difference is material, because distinguishing operates literally by re-describing facts, so constraining rule citation alone does not constrain evasion (addendum section 7, A6). (f) THE REALIST FRAME: records are dispositions, the norm is what a successor extracts; precedents are second-degree documents, products of a prior interpretation of other materials; no mechanism may presuppose recoverable collective intent - the will of a multi-agent council is not a discoverable fact, so mechanisms record DECLARED reasoning only; legal certainty is not a property texts have but an institutional achievement of disciplined, auditable interpretation, which is this layer's value proposition (addendum sections 1 and 7, A7).

ADOPT THE REALIST TERMINOLOGY EXPLICITLY AND SAY WHY IN ONE SENTENCE: 'determination', not 'identification' - identifying a ratio implies it pre-exists and is merely recognized (cognitivist thesis), determining implies the interpreter chooses it (realist thesis), and Serenissima adopts the realist reading precisely because a recorded choice must carry reasoning and be contestable (addendum section 2, terminological caution).
